PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Computer Science and Business Systems student (CGPA 8.8/10) focused on AI application and end-to-end web application development.
Builds user-facing applications integrating Generative AI, the Google Gemini API, REST APIs, databases, and ML frameworks.
Hands-on with Python, JavaScript, Flutter, TensorFlow, Keras, Firebase, Supabase, Git/GitHub, and AI-assisted development tools,
with a record of building and presenting real-world solutions through hackathons and innovation programs.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming: Python, Dart, JavaScript, C++, Java
Web & App Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Flutter, REST APIs, API Integration
AI / Machine Learning: Generative AI, Google Gemini API, AI Model Integration, TensorFlow, Keras, MobileNetV2, Machine Learning
Backend & Databases: Supabase, Firebase, Database Concepts, SQL
AI-Assisted Development & Tools: Antigravity, VS Code, Git, GitHub, Google Colab
Data & Analysis: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Power BI
Robotics / Simulation: ROS 2, Webots, Gazebo
Practices: Version Control, Documentation, Debugging, Problem Solving
PROJECTS
VentureIQ -- AI-Powered Startup Analysis Platform
Google Gemini API | Generative AI | HTML · CSS · JavaScript | Supabase | REST APIs | Git/GitHub | Antigravity
• Developed an AI-powered web application that analyzes startup ideas and presents structured feasibility, market, competitor, and roadmap
insights through an interactive dashboard.
• Integrated the Google Gemini API to generate structured AI analysis for startup feasibility, market landscape, competitor positioning, and strategic
roadmaps.
• Built four end-to-end modules -- Idea Discovery, Market Analysis, Competitor Analysis, and Roadmap Generation -- covering UI, API calls,
response handling, and result rendering.
• Integrated Supabase for backend and database functionality to persist user inputs and AI-generated results, while developing frontend workflows
in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with AI-assisted development tools.
AgriNova -- AI-Powered Smart Farming Application
Python | TensorFlow | Keras | MobileNetV2 | Generative AI | Firebase
• Developed an AI-powered smart farming application combining machine learning and Generative AI for agricultural decision support.
• Built a plant disease detection feature using TensorFlow, Keras, and MobileNetV2 with transfer learning for image classification.
• Integrated Generative AI for conversational assistance and recommendations, including crop rotation planning, organic input recommendations,
government scheme alerts, and multilingual assistance, backed by Firebase.
Caretroid -- AI Assistive Robot
Python | ROS 2 | Webots | Gazebo | AI Integration
• Developed an AI-assisted robotics system for intelligent navigation and user assistance using Python and ROS 2.
• Implemented autonomous navigation and voice guidance by simulating in Webots and Gazebo.
• Integrated AI capabilities into the navigation and assistance workflow; project secured INR 2 lakh funding through Startup Karnataka NAIN 2.0.
EXPERIENCE
Data Analytics Trainee -- iFutureTech
• Built Python (Pandas, NumPy) preprocessing and transformation workflows to clean and prepare real-world datasets for analysis.
• Created interactive Power BI dashboards and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Finance Research Intern -- Ultimez Technology Pvt. Ltd.
Project: Impact of FII and DII Activity on Indian Markets
• Analyzed FII and DII market activity using Python-based data analysis to study its effect on Indian markets.
• Researched trends and relationships in financial data and communicated results through visual summaries.
Data Science Intern -- Cognifyz Technologies
• Performed data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, and visualization in Python to solve defined analytical problems.
ACHIEVEMENTS
• 1st Place -- NEXORA National-Level Hackathon: ranked 1st among 100+ teams; won INR 30,000.
• Top 10 -- Startup Karnataka NAIN 2.0, IIIT Dharwad: selected among the top 10 teams; secured INR 2 lakh funding for the Caretroid project.
• 4th Position -- NeoNexus 3.0 / Ballari Hackathon: shortlisted among 40 teams from 189 participants; finished 4th in the top 10.
• Top 5 Academic Ranking: ranked among the top 5 students in the department, semesters 3--6; CGPA 8.8/10.
